ideas.idea: Remove noindex from Pricing or drop it from sitemap/nav (second Pricing note)
ideas.why: Duplicates a known problem only in framing, but the 'canonical points at itself' remark is harmless; this is the known pricing issue.

ideas.idea: Blog fetches /api/posts but no such route exists in the repo
ideas.why: Accurate: no api route in the files, and the report hedges that it may be served elsewhere, so the blog could render empty.

ideas.idea: Add a text list of plans and prices to Pricing to match its description
ideas.why: The page only says 'Free for up to three people' while the description promises plans, so concrete text helps readers and machines.

ideas.idea: Expand Docs with written setup steps
ideas.why: Docs is a single sentence, so real steps would give users and machines something to read and quote.

ideas.idea: Give each blog post its own URL and list it in the sitemap
ideas.why: Posts are only titles on one client-rendered page, so individual addresses would make them discoverable.

ideas.idea: Add Organization/SoftwareApplication JSON-LD to the home page once real details exist
ideas.why: Accurate and appropriately caveated, but it is standard advice with little effect on its own.
True that none are set, but the report itself says it only helps if pages are shared.

ideas.idea: Move /blog out of the client component so it can export server metadata (part of canonical item)
ideas.why: Accurate: a 'use client' file cannot export metadata, and this is the concrete step the canonical fix needs.
